_comment: The English narration of the video: each line starts speaking `at` seconds into its scene. Synthesised locally by video/narrate.py with Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0); 'Real-to-Sim' spells the names as they are said.

lines.text: Real-to-simulation builds simulations from real-world data.
It has long been studied, in research and in industry.
We invite you to build the infrastructure of real-to-simulation, together.
Two open-source resources, easy to use: Real-to-Sim Lab, and Awesome Real-to-Sim.
Recently, coding agents have begun to write simulation programs from recordings.
And several benchmarks now evaluate them.
Without a unified platform, every pair of method and benchmark needs its own glue.
With Real-to-Sim Lab, many coding agents and many benchmarks are each connected once.
Fair comparison. Every method runs in the same sandbox.
Its program is frozen, and re-run offline, without the answers.
Each benchmark then scores it with its own scorer.
One command. Write one experiment file, with any methods and any benchmarks.
One file. One command. One scorecard.
Awesome Real-to-Sim is a research map of nearly three hundred papers.
Key works sit on a roadmap.
Methods are sorted by what they deliver,
and benchmarks by what they ask for.
More is coming. Join us at Real-to-Sim Hub.
